title: Sherman on affecting the sine wave at will

tellings.quote: >> I could definitely affect the the motion and I could do it just at will.

plain: In the 1990s, at a National Security Agency complex in Maryland, a man named Dan Sherman says he could change the movement of a sine wave (the smooth up-and-down line of a wave signal) with his mind, whenever he chose. Sherman, who says on the show that he was taken into a UFO programme as a child, tells it first-hand: "I could definitely affect the motion and I could do it just at will." If true, it would mean a government agency was testing people for the power to move a signal by thought alone.
